object.definition: The public balanced binary partition tree recursively bisects diagonal blocks until their side length is at most $k$. Here $L=\lceil\log_2(d/k)\rceil$ and $d/2^L$ is an integer.

assumption.description: The public balanced binary block tree stops at block side length at most k. Set L=ceil(log2(d/k)), with d/2^L a positive integer.

norm.definition: Euclidean vector norm $\|z\|_2=(\sum_i|z_i|^2)^{1/2}$ and matrix operator norm $\|M\|_{\rm op}=\max_{\|z\|_2=1}\|Mz\|_2$; define $\|M\|_F=(\sum_{ij}|M_{ij}|^2)^{1/2}$.
